children.title: Bulkers
children.summary:
The Baltic index has corrected, closing today at 2752 points, 6.5% lower than last Friday's
2944 points. Regardless the s+p market continues to show strength, maintaining healthy volumes of
secondhand transactions, although activity has slightly declined compared to earlier in the summer.

children.title: Demolition
children.summary:
Pakistan and Bangladesh continue to maintain very strong levels due to the limited
availability of tonnage. It is important to note that Pakistan has not been tested recently, as no vessels
have been sold there in the past couple of months.
